'''Tanus Spijek''' was an [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] who was hired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], delivering messages from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], and serving as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the Alliance. At some point by the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Spijek left the Alliance, and joined the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|organization]] which operated on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Spijek carried out extortion activities for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. 

In 4 ABY, the Elom was present in the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on Tatooine when the Alliance's [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] in an attempt to rescue fellow Hero of Yavin [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by Jabba. Those events led to Jabba sentencing Solo and fellow Heroes of Yavin [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], although the captives fought back, with Jabba being killed and his [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]] [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] destroyed with Spijek onboard in the subsequent [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].

==Biography==
===Alliance service and joining Jabba===
[[File:Vigrriev.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Tanus Spijek, who served both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Jabba the Hutt]]
The [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Tanus Spijek lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CCG" /> At some point between [[1 BBY/Legends|1]]<ref name="SWTCC">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' dates ''[[Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika 5]]'', where the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] establishes their base in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], before the Empire [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the latter [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Spijek was hired by the Alliance to deliver messages between Alderaan and the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]],<ref name="CCG" /> the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] headquarters on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> He<ref name="Hasbro" /> also served as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the Alliance.<ref name="CCG" />

At some point by the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Spijek had left the Alliance<ref name="CCG" /> and joined the [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|organization]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] based on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Spijek served in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on Tatooine, carrying out extortion activities for Jabba.<ref name="Complete Visual" />

===Festivities and rescue of Han Solo===
[[File:Spijek-RaiseAGlass-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Tanus Spijek (center) raising a glass to the death of Oola]]
In 4 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> Spijek was in the throne room of Jabba's palace, sitting in one of the booths, when the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] performed their song "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]." Jabba had a second performance of the song occur, which ended with the Hutt dropping the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancer [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] into the pit of his [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|pet rancor]], with the Elom remaining in his seat during Oola's [[Death/Legends|demise]].<ref name="rotj" />

Immediately after, Alliance leader&mdash;and one of the Alliance's [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]&mdash;[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|arrived]] with the intention of rescuing her ally [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] of the Hutt. Organa arrived with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], ostensibly her captive, and threatened to destroy the palace with a [[Class-A thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. After winning Jabba's favor, Organa [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|rescued]] Solo on that [[Standard day/Legends|night]], before both Organa and Solo were caught and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]].<ref name="rotj" />

===Luke Skywalker's arrival and Jabba's death===
[[File:Tanus_Spijek_Jabbas_palace.png|thumb|left|300px|Tanus Spijek (left) watching Luke Skywalker being sentenced to death]]
The next morning,<ref name="ROTJ junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> Spijek was among the courtiers [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] on the throne room's floor, when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;also, with Solo and Chewbacca, part of the Heroes of Yavin&mdash;arrived to demand the freedom of Chewbacca, Organa, and Solo. Skywalker was in turn dropped into the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] pit by Jabba, although he ended up killing the rancor. Spijek and others in the throne room watched as Jabba sentenced Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca to death at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="rotj" />

Spijek and others in the palace accompanied Jabba to the Great Pit of Carkoon aboard the Hutt's [[Luxury-class sail barge|luxury sail barge]], the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. However, the captives ended up fighting back against the Hutt. In the subsequent [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], Jabba was killed and the ''Khetanna'' was destroyed.<ref name="rotj" />

==Personality and traits==
Although most Eloms were sympathetic to the Alliance, Tanus Spijek, a vile opportunist,<ref name="Complete Visual" /> was supporting Jabba when he captured or attempted to kill the Alliance's Heroes of Yavin.<ref name="rotj" /> He interacted with few others at the crime lord's palace,<ref name="Complete Visual" /> and also raised a glass while he watched Oola get attacked and eaten by Jabba's rancor. Spijek reacted with fear when Organa entered the palace, and panicked when she threatened to destroy the palace with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].<ref name="rotj" />

Spijek had a thick, [[Oil/Legends|oily]] pelt<ref name="Complete Visual" /> which was mottled [[Color/Legends|gray]], brown, and white.<ref name="rotj" /> He had calloused skin<ref name="Complete Visual" /> which was gray and pink, and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="rotj" />

==Equipment==
Spijek carried a [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blaster]].<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Spijek_concept.png|thumb|right|300px|Nilo Rodis-Jamero's illustration of Tanus Spijek]]
Tanus Spijek first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="rotj" /> where he was portrayed by at least one extra wearing a full-body costume.<ref name="DB">{{DB|species|eloms|Eloms}}</ref> Before the film's [[May 25]], 1983 release,<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/critical-opinion-return-of-the-jedi-original-reviews|text=Critical Opinion: ''Return of the Jedi'' Original Reviews}}</ref> the character was developed in sketches by [[Chris Walas]],<ref name="DB" /> and artist [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] did an illustration of Spijek around spring [[1981]], showing the Elom wearing an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and using a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] to kill another being.<ref name="Making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> For its obvious underground inspiration,<ref name="DB" /> the character was later known as "The Mole" during production and its mask was based on a maquette that was designed with lighter gray fur.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> The scenes that featured Spijek were filmed between [[January 25]] and [[March 1]], [[1982]], with the Jabba's Palace scenes filmed in [[Elstree Studios]]'s stage 8, and the scenes on the ''Khetanna'' filmed on stage 9 at Elstree Studios.<ref name="Making" /> In the same year as the ''Return of the Jedi'' film, Spijek was also included in the ''[[Return of the Jedi Monster Activity Book]]'', where he was described as a slimy creature and shown capturing the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] calling for help in the [[Binary/Legends|Binary]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Activity book">''[[Return of the Jedi Monster Activity Book]]''</ref>

In [[1998]], Spijek was named in a card for the ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" /> On [[April 4]], [[2000]],<ref name="Fan">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2000/03/news20000313.html|text=Star Wars Insider #48}}</ref> "[[The Last Page]]," an article in the [[Star Wars Insider 48|48th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, used an image of Spijek to represent the character [[Vigrriev]].<ref name="Insider">[[Star Wars Insider 48|''Star Wars Insider'' 48]]</ref> While nothing has officially addressed the discrepancy, this article assumes that Spijek is the Elom seen in the ''Return of the Jedi'' film, with the Vigrriev identification an error.
